items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1960-01-21
items.q: Boy, he played with Peerrell until Peerrell died.

ctx.x: Yeah, I heard talk about him.

Oh, yeah. He used to play with people. And then he played with us. And then he played with George Williams, big George Williams. Then he had a band, you know. Boy, he played with Peerrell until Peerrell died. Then after that, he didn't spend with anybody, you know. Work all the time. He was a printer, you know. Played music at night. He was a heavy drinker. He was the finest man in one of me. He didn't look at him up there. I used to play with him sometimes too. Me and him and Eddie Hickman. Three piece. He could…
